evidence: 14 of 33 columns possess heterogeneous data types (int64/double/null)
proposed_handling: Enforce lossless unified typed schema established in Step 02
methodological_reason: Prevents memory bloating and Arrow serialization errors without altering values.

problem: Structural temporal missingness due to evolving Basel regimes
proposed_handling: Preserve structural nulls; evaluate native tree-based missingness handling or fit-on-train imputers
methodological_reason: Backfilling older periods using modern values violates point-in-time constraints (look-ahead bias).

evidence: Median |Q4|/|Q1| ~ 4 with Q1 saw-tooth resets for: NETINC, INTINC, EINTEXP, NONII, NONIX, ELNATR
proposed_handling: Implement within-year quarterly de-cumulation in Step 04 for consecutive reports; retain Q1 as reported
methodological_reason: Avoids distorting financial profitability ratios by mixing multi-quarter flows with single-quarter assets.

problem: Internal reporting hiatuses between bank inception and exit
proposed_handling: Do not impute missing quarters; construct rolling/lagged features strictly on calendar dates, not row offsets
methodological_reason: Prevents computing rolling growth metrics across non-consecutive temporal intervals.

problem: Supervisory rule violations (e.g. non-positive assets or negative deposits)
evidence: R04: 96 rows; R05: 2 rows; R07: 32 rows; R08: 6 rows; R09: 2 rows; R11: 9 rows; R12: 3 rows; R15: 2 rows; R16: 646 rows; R18: 2 rows
proposed_handling: Flag accounting violations; set invalid denominators to NaN; preserve legitimate distress signals (EQ<=0)
methodological_reason: Arbitrary row dropping risks removing near-insolvent banks, introducing survivorship bias.

problem: Failure registry records unmatchable to Call Report panel by CERT
evidence: 0 null CERTs; 22 unmatched CERTs (in study scope)
proposed_handling: Audit unmatched entities; document as regulatory perimeter difference (e.g., non-reporting branches)
methodological_reason: Prevents misattributing failed institutions as healthy operational entities.

problem: Multiple failure events associated with a single bank charter
evidence: 77 in-scope failure rows with repeated CERT numbers
proposed_handling: Use unique failure ID as surrogate key; link failures to active reporting episodes chronologically
methodological_reason: Captures multi-stage FDIC assistance transactions without duplicate row collisions.

problem: Financial filings observed after recorded failure date
evidence: 439 linked failures exhibit filings dated after failure date
proposed_handling: Censor observations post-failure date in Step 04; label only valid operating quarters prior to failure
methodological_reason: Eliminates potential label leakage from receivership or resolution filings.

problem: Banks ceasing filings without FDIC failure designation (M&A / Voluntary exits)
evidence: 16541 banks disappear from panel without matching FDIC failure registry
proposed_handling: Classify as M&A/voluntary exit (label y=0); apply right-censoring in the 4 quarters preceding absorption
methodological_reason: Assigning target y=1 to healthy merged banks would severely corrupt early-warning precision.

problem: Terminal regulatory snapshot fields in Institutions table
evidence: Institutions table provides current status (ACTIVE=27835 records)
proposed_handling: Strictly isolate Institutions fields to exit categorization; exclude entirely from model feature matrices
methodological_reason: Using terminal statuses as model inputs would directly trigger the exam's Leakage Gate penalty.
